verdict.rationale: Jules can take a GitHub issue labeled "jules" as a task and produce a reviewable plan before making code changes, which loosely amounts to turning a submitted request into a scoped work plan. Its API also allows custom workflows from tools like Linear and Slack. However, it is built to execute coding tasks rather than turn raw user feedback into structured task specs, so a product manager would need to build their own intake workflow. Missing for 10: native ingestion of user feedback submissions, structured task/spec output (e.g., tickets with acceptance criteria and scope breakdown), a documented PM-facing intake workflow, and independent corroboration of this use.
